Require Import List.

Require Import Nat.

Require Import Util.

From Corelib Require Import Init.Wf.

From Stdlib Require Import PeanoNat.

Require Import Wellfounded.Transitive_Closure.

Require Import Wellfounded.Inverse_Image.

Require Import Relation_Definitions.

Import Relation_Operators.

Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Inductive UIType {Lit : Type} : Type :=
| TTop : UIType
| TBot : UIType
| TUni (l r : UIType) : UIType
| TIsect (l r : UIType) : UIType
| TLit (l : Lit) : UIType
.

Arguments UIType : clear implicits.

Section DSub.

Variable Lit : Type.

Notation T := (UIType Lit).

Variable DRule : Lit -> Lit -> Type.

Variable DPremise : forall (l r : Lit), DRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop.

Inductive dsuba {Assumed : T -> T -> Prop} : T -> T -> Prop :=
| dsuba_refl : forall t : T, dsuba t t
| dsuba_trans : forall tl tm tr : T, dsuba tl tm -> dsuba tm tr -> dsuba tl tr
| dsuba_assume : forall tl tr : T, Assumed tl tr -> dsuba tl tr
| dsuba_lit : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : DRule ll lr), (forall ptl ptr : T, DPremise ll lr r ptl ptr -> dsuba ptl ptr) -> dsuba (TLit ll) (TLit lr)
| dsuba_top : forall t : T, dsuba t TTop
| dsuba_bot : forall t : T, dsuba TBot t
| dsuba_uni_l : forall tl tr t : T, dsuba tl t -> dsuba tr t -> dsuba (TUni tl tr) t
| dsuba_uni_rl : forall tl tr : T, dsuba tl (TUni tl tr)
| dsuba_uni_rr : forall tl tr : T, dsuba tr (TUni tl tr)
| dsuba_int_r : forall t tl tr : T, dsuba t tl -> dsuba t tr -> dsuba t (TIsect tl tr)
| dsuba_int_ll : forall tl tr : T, dsuba (TIsect tl tr) tl
| dsuba_int_lr : forall tl tr : T, dsuba (TIsect tl tr) tr
.

Arguments dsuba : clear implicits.

Definition dsubf : T -> T -> Prop :=
  dsuba (fun _ _ => False).

End DSub.

Arguments dsuba {Lit DRule}.

Arguments dsuba_refl {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_trans {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_assume {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_lit {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_top {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_bot {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_uni_l {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_uni_rl {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_uni_rr {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_int_r {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_int_ll {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsuba_int_lr {Lit DRule DPremise}.

Arguments dsubf {Lit DRule}.

Section RSub.

Variable Lit : Type.

Notation T := (UIType Lit).

Variable RRule : Lit -> Lit -> Type.

Variable RPremise : forall (l r : Lit), RRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop.

Inductive uisub {R : Lit -> Lit -> Prop} : T -> T -> Prop :=
| ui_lit (ll lr : Lit) : R ll lr -> uisub (TLit ll) (TLit lr)
| ui_top (tl : T) : uisub tl TTop
| ui_int_ll (il ir tr : T) : uisub il tr -> uisub (TIsect il ir) tr
| ui_int_lr (il ir tr : T) : uisub ir tr -> uisub (TIsect il ir) tr
| ui_int_r (tl il ir : T) : uisub tl il -> uisub tl ir -> uisub tl (TIsect il ir)
| ui_bot (tr : T) : uisub TBot tr
| ui_uni_rl (tl ul ur : T) : uisub tl ul -> uisub tl (TUni ul ur)
| ui_uni_rr (tl ul ur : T) : uisub tl ur -> uisub tl (TUni ul ur)
| ui_uni_l (ul ur tr : T) : uisub ul tr -> uisub ur tr -> uisub (TUni ul ur) tr
.

Arguments uisub : clear implicits.

Inductive lsub (R : T -> T -> Prop) (ll lr : Lit) : Prop :=
| Lsub (r : RRule ll lr) : (forall tl tr : T, RPremise ll lr r tl tr -> R tl tr) -> lsub R ll lr
.

Inductive rsubf : T -> T -> Prop :=
| Rsubf (tl tr : T) : uisub (lsub (rsubf)) tl tr -> rsubf tl tr
.

Inductive rsubam {Assumed : T -> T -> Prop} : T -> T -> Prop :=
| ram_assumption (tl tr : T) : Assumed tl tr -> rsubam tl tr
| ram_mono (tl tl' tr' tr : T) : rsubf tl tl' -> rsubam tl' tr' -> rsubf tr' tr -> rsubam tl tr
| ram_lit (ll lr : Lit) (r : RRule ll lr) : (forall pl pr : T, RPremise ll lr r pl pr -> rsubam pl pr) -> rsubam (TLit ll) (TLit lr)
| ram_top (tl : T) : rsubam tl TTop
| ram_int_ll (il ir tr : T) : rsubam il tr -> rsubam (TIsect il ir) tr
| ram_int_lr (il ir tr : T) : rsubam ir tr -> rsubam (TIsect il ir) tr
| ram_int_r (tl il ir : T) : rsubam tl il -> rsubam tl ir -> rsubam tl (TIsect il ir)
| ram_bot (tr : T) : rsubam TBot tr
| ram_uni_rl (tl ul ur : T) : rsubam tl ul -> rsubam tl (TUni ul ur)
| ram_uni_rr (tl ul ur : T) : rsubam tl ur -> rsubam tl (TUni ul ur)
| ram_uni_l (ul ur tr : T) : rsubam ul tr -> rsubam ur tr -> rsubam (TUni ul ur) tr
.

Arguments rsubam : clear implicits.

End RSub.

Arguments uisub { Lit }.

Arguments ui_lit {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_top {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_int_ll {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_int_lr {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_int_r {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_bot {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_uni_l {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_uni_rl {Lit R}.

Arguments ui_uni_rr {Lit R}.

Arguments lsub {Lit RRule}.

Arguments Lsub {Lit RRule}.

Arguments rsubf {Lit RRule}.

Arguments rsubam {Lit RRule}.

Arguments ram_assumption {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_mono {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_lit {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_top {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_int_ll {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_int_lr {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_int_r {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_bot {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_uni_l {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_uni_rl {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Arguments ram_uni_rr {Lit RRule RPremise Assumed}.

Inductive subui {Lit : Type} : UIType Lit -> UIType Lit -> Prop :=
| sub_uni_l : forall (t tr : UIType Lit) , subui t (TUni t tr)
| sub_uni_r : forall (t tl : UIType Lit) , subui t (TUni tl t)
| sub_isect_l : forall (t tr : UIType Lit) , subui t (TIsect t tr)
| sub_isect_r : forall (t tl : UIType Lit) , subui t (TIsect tl t)
.

Module Type Traditional.

Parameter Lit : Type.

Notation T := (UIType Lit).

Parameter DRule : Lit -> Lit -> Type.

Parameter DPremise : forall {l r : Lit}, DRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop.

Notation dsub := (dsubf (@DPremise)).

Parameter RRule : Lit -> Lit -> Type.

Parameter RPremise : forall {l r : Lit}, RRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop.

Notation rsub := (rsubf (@RPremise)).

Parameter SyntaxDirectedness_Rules : forall ll lr : Lit, { rrules : list (RRule ll lr) | forall r : RRule ll lr, In r rrules }.

Parameter SyntaxDirectedness_Premises : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr), { rpremises : list (prod T T) | forall pl pr : T, RPremise r pl pr <-> In (pair pl pr) rpremises }.

Parameter M : Type.

Parameter mlt : M -> M -> Prop.

Parameter mltwf : well_founded mlt.

Parameter m : T -> T -> M.

Parameter m_ui_l : forall (tl tl' tr : T), subui tl tl' -> (clos_refl_trans M mlt) (m tl tr) (m tl' tr).

Parameter m_ui_r : forall (tl tr tr' : T), subui tr tr' -> (clos_refl_trans M mlt) (m tl tr) (m tl tr').

Parameter m_lit : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr), forall pl pr : T, RPremise r pl pr -> mlt (m pl pr) (m (TLit ll) (TLit lr)).

Parameter LiteralReflexivity : forall l : Lit, exists r : RRule l l, forall pl pr : T, RPremise r pl pr -> pl = pr.

Parameter RRuleToDProof : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr), dsuba (@DPremise) (RPremise r) (TLit ll) (TLit lr).

Parameter DRuleToRProof : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : DRule ll lr), rsubam (@RPremise) (DPremise r) (TLit ll) (TLit lr).

Parameter LiteralTransitivity : forall {ll lm lr : Lit} (rl : RRule ll lm) (rr : RRule lm lr),
     exists r : RRule ll lr,
       forall pl pr : T, RPremise r pl pr ->
          exists pm : T, (rsubam (@RPremise) (RPremise rl) pl pm /\ rsubam (@RPremise) (RPremise rr) pm pr) \/ (rsubam (@RPremise) (RPremise rr) pl pm /\ rsubam (@RPremise) (RPremise rl) pm pr).

End Traditional.
=====SEC4=====
Require Import List.

Require Import Nat.

Require Import Util.

From Corelib Require Import Init.Wf.

Require Import Wellfounded.Inverse_Image.

Require Import Section3_Requirements.

Import Relation_Operators.

Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Section Integrator.

Variable Lit : Type.

Notation T := (UIType Lit).

Variable DRule : Lit -> Lit -> Type.

Variable DPremise : forall (l r : Lit), DRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop.

Definition Intersect : list Lit -> T
  := fold_right (fun l => TIsect (TLit l)) TTop.

Fixpoint Integrate (intersect : list Lit -> T) (t : T) : T :=
    match t with
    | TBot => TBot
    | TTop => intersect []
    | TUni tl tr => TUni (Integrate intersect tl) (Integrate intersect tr)
    | TIsect tl tr => Integrate (fun l => Integrate (fun l' => intersect (l ++ l')) tr) tl
    | TLit l => intersect [l]
    end.

Fixpoint Integrated_int (intersected : list Lit -> Prop) (t : T) : Prop :=
    match t with
    | TBot => False
    | TTop => intersected []
    | TUni tl tr => False
    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int (fun l => Integrated_int (fun l' => intersected (l ++ l')) tr) tl
    | TLit l => intersected [l]
    end.

Fixpoint Integrated (intersected : list Lit -> Prop) (t : T) : Prop :=
    match t with
    | TBot => True
    | TTop => intersected []
    | TUni tl tr => (Integrated intersected tl) /\ (Integrated intersected tr)
    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int intersected (TIsect tl tr)
    | TLit l => intersected [l]
    end.

Fixpoint Exists_Intersection (P : list Lit -> Prop) (t : T) : Prop :=
    match t with
    | TBot => False
    | TTop => P []
    | TUni tl tr => (Exists_Intersection P tl) \/ (Exists_Intersection P tr)
    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int P (TIsect tl tr)
    | TLit l => P [l]
    end.

Inductive sig2T {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} : Type :=
    exist2T (a : A) (b : B) (c : C a b).

Arguments sig2T { A B }.

Definition proj2T1 {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (s : sig2T C) : A :=
    match s with exist2T a _ _ => a end.

Definition proj2T2 {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (s : sig2T C) : B :=
    match s with exist2T _ b _ => b end.

Definition proj2V {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (v : sig2T C) : C (proj2T1 v) (proj2T2 v) :=
    match v as v0 return C (proj2T1 v0) (proj2T2 v0) with
    | exist2T _ _ c => c
    end.

Inductive dsubda {Assumed : T -> T -> Prop} : T -> T -> Prop :=
  | dsubda_refl : forall t : T, dsubda t t
  | dsubda_trans : forall tl tm tr : T, dsubda tl tm -> dsubda tm tr -> dsubda tl tr
  | dsubda_assume : forall tl tr : T, Assumed tl tr -> dsubda tl tr
  | dsubda_lit : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : DRule ll lr), (forall ptl ptr : T, DPremise ll lr r ptl ptr -> dsubda ptl ptr) -> dsubda (TLit ll) (TLit lr)
  | dsubda_top : forall t : T, dsubda t TTop
  | dsubda_bot : forall t : T, dsubda TBot t
  | dsubda_uni_l : forall tl tr t : T, dsubda tl t -> dsubda tr t -> dsubda (TUni tl tr) t
  | dsubda_uni_rl : forall tl tr : T, dsubda tl (TUni tl tr)
  | dsubda_uni_rr : forall tl tr : T, dsubda tr (TUni tl tr)
  | dsubda_int_r : forall t tl tr : T, dsubda t tl -> dsubda t tr -> dsubda t (TIsect tl tr)
  | dsubda_int_ll : forall tl tr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl tr) tl
  | dsubda_int_lr : forall tl tr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl tr) tr
  | dsubda_dist : forall tl trl trr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl (TUni trl trr)) (TUni (TIsect tl trl) (TIsect tl trr))
  .

Arguments dsubda : clear implicits.

End Integrator.

Arguments Intersect {Lit}.

Arguments Integrate {Lit}.

Arguments Integrated_int {Lit}.

Arguments Integrated {Lit}.

Arguments Exists_Intersection {Lit}.

Arguments sig2T {A B}.

(* ---------- verified pieces ---------- *)

Lemma rsubfR_Intersect_mem : forall ls (X : T) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@RPremise) X (Intersect ls) -> rsubf (@RPremise) X (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls. induction ls as [| a q IH]; intros X l Hin H.
  - destruct Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq | Hin].
    + subst l.
      change (rsubf (@RPremise) X (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q))) in H.
      exact (proj1 (rsubfR_int_r_inv X (TLit a) (Intersect q) H)).
    + change (rsubf (@RPremise) X (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q))) in H.
      apply (IH X l Hin (proj2 (rsubfR_int_r_inv X (TLit a) (Intersect q) H))).
Qed.

Lemma rsubfR_lit_mem : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@RPremise) (intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls l Hin.
  apply rsubfR_Intersect_mem with (ls := ls) (X := intersect ls);
    [ exact Hin | apply LiteralDereliction ].
Qed.

(* The exact missing bridge: integration of the left index. *)
Axiom IPremise_lift :
  forall p q : T, rsubf (@RPremise) p q -> rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q.

Definition weaken_IP (X Y : T)
  (IHord : forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf (@RPremise) X' Y' -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y')
  (X0 Y0 : T) (H0 : ord (X0,Y0) (X,Y)) :
  forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X0,Y0) -> rsubf (@RPremise) X' Y' -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y'
:= fun X' Y' Ho H => IHord X' Y' (ord_trans (X',Y') (X0,Y0) (X,Y) Ho H0) H.

Lemma uisub_RP_to_IP_aux : forall X Y,
  uisub (lsub (@RPremise) (rsubf (@RPremise))) X Y ->
  (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf (@RPremise) X' Y' -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y') ->
  uisub (lsub (@IPremise) (rsubf (@IPremise))) X Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y Hu. induction Hu; intros IHord.
  - destruct H as [r Hprem].
    apply ui_lit.
    apply Lsub with (r := r).
    intros p q Hip.
    inversion Hip as [pl pr Hrp]; subst.
    apply IPremise_lift. apply Hprem. exact Hrp.
  - apply ui_top.
  - apply ui_int_ll.
    apply IHHu.
    apply (weaken_IP (TIsect il ir) tr IHord il tr (ord_sub_l il tr (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_l il ir))).
  - apply ui_int_lr.
    apply IHHu.
    apply (weaken_IP (TIsect il ir) tr IHord ir tr (ord_sub_l ir tr (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_r ir il))).
  - apply ui_int_r.
    + apply IHHu1.
      apply (weaken_IP tl (TIsect il ir) IHord tl il (ord_sub_r tl il (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_l il ir))).
    + apply IHHu2.
      apply (weaken_IP tl (TIsect il ir) IHord tl ir (ord_sub_r tl ir (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_r ir il))).
  - apply ui_bot.
  - apply ui_uni_rl.
    apply IHHu.
    apply (weaken_IP tl (TUni ul ur) IHord tl ul (ord_sub_r tl ul (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_l ul ur))).
  - apply ui_uni_rr.
    apply IHHu.
    apply (weaken_IP tl (TUni ul ur) IHord tl ur (ord_sub_r tl ur (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_r ur ul))).
  - apply ui_uni_l.
    + apply IHHu1.
      apply (weaken_IP (TUni ul ur) tr IHord ul tr (ord_sub_l ul tr (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_l ul ur))).
    + apply IHHu2.
      apply (weaken_IP (TUni ul ur) tr IHord ur tr (ord_sub_l ur tr (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_r ur ul))).
Qed.

Lemma rsubf_RP_to_IP : forall X Y, rsubf (@RPremise) X Y -> rsubf (@IPremise) X Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y H.
  refine (rsubf_wf_ind (@RPremise) (fun X Y => rsubf (@IPremise) X Y) _ X Y H).
  intros X0 Y0 IH Hr.
  inversion Hr; subst.
  apply Rsubf.
  eapply uisub_RP_to_IP_aux; [ exact H0 | exact IH ].
Qed.

Lemma isub_intersect_mem : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls l Hin.
  apply rsubf_RP_to_IP. apply rsubfR_lit_mem. exact Hin.
Qed.

## Verdict

I could not close `rsubf_cut`, and I did not find a rigorous countermodel. The obstruction is sharper than "ram_mono is annoying": the natural proof requires three lemmas that are mutually circular at the atomic case, and the interface exposes no measure that breaks the cycle. Below is the exact obstruction and the strongest concrete plan I can defend.

## 1. Why the obvious well-founded inductions fail

`rsubf_ind` is useless for recursion: for `rsubf RP` it has shape

```
forall tl tr, uisub (lsub RP (rsubf RP)) tl tr -> P tl tr
```

with no IH for the nested premises. So the only available induction is `rsubf_wf_ind` on `ord (X,Y)`.

For cut on `R_IP`, the two natural statements are both stuck:

**A. wf on the target pair `(X,Z)`.** This handles all structural cases by `ord_sub_l` / `ord_sub_r`, and even atom-atom, because a premise `(p,q)` of the composed rule satisfies `ord (I p, q) (TLit ll, TLit lr)` (`ord_lit_IP`). But it cannot handle the mixed-structure cases:

```
H1 = ui_int_r : X <= TIsect il ir      (premises X<=il, X<=ir)
H2 = ui_int_ll : TIsect il ir <= Z     (premise il<=Z)
```

The only composition is `X<=il` with `il<=Z`, i.e. exactly the target pair `(X,Z)`, not smaller. Same for `ui_uni_rl/rr` against `ui_uni_l`.

**B. wf on the first-derivation pair `(X,Y)`.** This fixes the two cases above: `(X,il)` is `ord_sub_r` below `(X, TIsect il ir)` (and dually `ord_sub_l`). It also handles all structural premises of the first derivation. But it fails atom-atom: the required obligation is

```
R_IP (I p) q      for each RPremise r p q,   r = composed rule from LiteralTransitivity
```

and no first derivation at `(I p, q)` is available. `W : R_IP p q -> R_IP (I p) q` would bridge this, but `W` itself is not derivable from the interface without the missing `intersect` lemma.

## 2. The mutual circle

The needed auxiliary chain is:

```
(C)  rsubf_cut  : R_IP X Y -> R_IP Y Z -> R_IP X Z
(W)  W          : R_IP X Y -> R_IP (I X) Y
(H)  Hmem       : forall ls a, In a ls -> intersected ls ->
                    rsubf IP (intersect ls) (TLit a)
(T)  Conv       : rsubf RP X Y -> rsubf IP X Y
(I)  Interp     : rsubam RP A X Y ->
                    (forall p q, A p q -> R_IP (I p) q) -> R_IP (I X) Y
```

- `(C)` atom-atom needs `(I)` to turn `LiteralTransitivity`'s `rsubam (RPremise rl) p pm` into `R_IP (I p) pm`.
- `(I)` ram_mono needs two instances of `(C)` at `(tl,tr')` and `(tl,tr)`, with **no** `m` relation between `tl',tr'` and `tl,tr`. This is the hard case:
  ```
  rsubf RP tl tl' -> rsubam A tl' tr' -> rsubf RP tr' tr -> rsubam A tl tr
  ```
- `(T)` atom case needs `(W)` at each premise pair `(p,q)` (which is `ord`-smaller by `m_lit`, so this part is legitimate).
- `(W)` atom case `X = TLit ll, Y = TLit lr` needs `R_IP (intersect [ll]) (TLit lr)`, which is exactly `(H)`/`(C)`. This is the same "opaque `intersect`" gap the file comment mentions.
- `(H)` is the only route I can see out, and it is precisely what `LiteralPromotion` + `Integrated` are designed to supply.

The syntactic rank idea does work for the same-pair `P1/P2` cases: `rsubf = Rsubf uisub`, and `uisub` is an ordinary inductive, so one can define `uisub_rank` by structural recursion ignoring the opaque `lsub` argument, then use the lexicographic measure `(ord(X,Z), uisub_rank H1, uisub_rank H2)`. Both `P1` and `P2` decrease the rank of a premise of `H1` or `H2`. This solves everything except `(I)`/ram_mono and `(H)`.

`SyntaxDirectedness_Premises` does let you define a genuine derivation height for `rsubf RP`/`rsubf IP`: enumerate the finite premise list at `ui_lit`, recurse by `well_founded_induction wf_ord`, and include the `(I p,q)` subderivations (which are `ord`-smaller by `ord_lit_IP`). But this height bounds only the `rsubf` trees, not the arbitrary `rsubam` trees returned by `LiteralTransitivity`; ram_mono's two cuts can be at pairs with larger height and larger `m`, so the lexicographic measure does not close.

## 3. The only viable route I see

Prove `(H)` from `LiteralPromotion`, not from cut. The intended instantiation is at `ls' := [a]` with `rs` a list of rules whose targets enumerate `ls'` and whose sources lie in `ls`, so that the `Exists_Intersection` conclusion applies to `intersect [a]`. The exact statement to target is the intersected-conditional form:

```
Lemma Hmem :
  forall (ls : list Lit) (a : Lit),
    In a ls -> intersected ls ->
    rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect ls) (TLit a).
```

and the more useful list form, which is what the later `isub_prefix_lit_of_mem` in `Task.v` is waiting for:

```
Lemma Hlist :
  forall ls, intersected ls ->
    rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect ls) (Intersect ls).
```

Then:
1. `W` atom case follows from `Hlist` plus the atom edge `Intersect [ll] = TLit ll` and a composition step (or directly from `Hmem`).
2. `Conv` follows by `rsubf_wf_ind RP` with `Q X Y := rsubf IP X Y`, using `m_lit`/`ord_lit_R` at the `ui_lit` premise pairs and `W` at those smaller pairs.
3. `Interp` follows by structural induction on `rsubam`, with ram_mono discharged by `Conv` and the cut instances; the cut instances at `(tl,tr')`, `(tl,tr)` are then at *ground* terms whose `rsubf` structure is fixed by the ram_mono node, so a secondary induction on the ram_mono fields replaces the missing `m` bound.
4. `rsubf_cut` then follows by wf on `(X,Z)` plus `uisub_rank`, with the atom case discharged by `Interp` + `W`.

Without `Hmem`/`Hlist`, `(W)` at `ui_lit` is not provable: the goal becomes `R_IP (intersect [ll]) (TLit lr)` and no constructor of `rsubf`/`uisub` can introduce the opaque term `intersect [ll]` from whole cloth. `LiteralDereliction` gives only `rsubf RP (intersect ls) (Intersect ls)`, and converting `RP` to `IP` at that term is exactly `(Conv)` at a pair whose premises are the shifted ones, i.e. circular.

## 4. Countermodel status (important)

There is a consistent model of **all** Parameters that shows why one must be careful:

```
Lit arbitrary; RRule ll lr := unit; RPremise := empty
DPremise := empty; DRule := unit; extension := False
intersect := Intersect ; intersected := fun _ => True
m := sum of weights of distinct literals in the pair; mlt := lt
```

Check: `LiteralReflexivity`, `RRuleToDProof`, `DRuleToRProof`, `LiteralTransitivity` are vacuous (empty premises); `LiteralDereliction` is `refl_R`; `IntersectorSoundness` is `dsubda_refl`; `IntersectorIntegrated` holds because `Integrated True (Intersect ls)` reduces to `intersected ls`; `LiteralPromotion` holds by choosing `rs'` to be a per-target selection from `rs` (the `rsubam` condition is `ram_assumption`, since the selected rule belongs to `rs`); `MeasurePreservation` holds because `Intersect` never introduces new literals.

In this model `RPremise` is empty, so every `lsub IP ll lr` is vacuous and `R_IP` contains **all** literal pairs. The resulting full `uisub` relation is transitive in the cases I checked, so **this model is not a countermodel to cut**. I could not deform it to a non-transitive one: any bad atom needs a nonempty `RPremise` and a bad `R_IP (I p) q`, and `LiteralTransitivity` + `m_lit` + `mltwf` then force an `m`-descending chain of offending premises. That is evidence (not proof) that cut is true rather than false.

So I do **not** recommend claiming impossibility. The concrete next move is to attack `Hlist` from `LiteralPromotion`: it is the single missing interface-level lemma that breaks the cycle and unlocks `W`, `Conv`, `Interp`, and finally `rsubf_cut`.

Fixpoint size (t : T) : nat :=
  match t with
  | TTop => 0 | TBot => 0 | TLit _ => 1
  | TUni a b => S (size a + size b)
  | TIsect a b => S (size a + size b)
  end.

Lemma subui_size : forall a b, subui a b -> size a < size b.
Proof. intros a b H. induction H; cbn; lia. Qed.

Lemma crt_eq_or_trans : forall a b : M, clos_refl_trans M mlt a b -> a = b \/ clos_trans M mlt a b.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H.
  - right. apply t_step. assumption.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - destruct IHclos_refl_trans1 as [-> | H1]; destruct IHclos_refl_trans2 as [-> | H2].
    + left; reflexivity.
    + right; assumption.
    + right; assumption.
    + right. eapply t_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma crt_mlt : forall a b c : M, clos_refl_trans M mlt a b -> mlt b c -> clos_trans M mlt a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H Hbc. destruct (crt_eq_or_trans a b H) as [-> | Ht].
  - apply t_step; exact Hbc.
  - eapply t_trans; [exact Ht | apply t_step; exact Hbc].
Qed.

Definition mval (p : T*T) : M := m (fst p) (snd p).
Definition sval (p : T*T) : nat := size (fst p) + size (snd p).
Definition ord (p q : T*T) : Prop :=
  slexprod M nat (clos_trans M mlt) lt (mval p, sval p) (mval q, sval q).

Lemma wf_ord : well_founded ord.
Proof.
  unfold ord.
  apply wf_inverse_image with (f := fun p : T*T => (mval p, sval p)).
  apply wf_slexprod; [apply wf_clos_trans, mltwf | apply lt_wf].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ind_pair : forall (P : T -> T -> Prop),
  (forall X Y, (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> P X' Y') -> P X Y) ->
  forall X Y, P X Y.
Proof.
  intros P Hstep X Y.
  enough (H : forall p : T*T, P (fst p) (snd p)) by (apply (H (X,Y))).
  apply (well_founded_ind wf_ord (fun p => P (fst p) (snd p))).
  intros [X' Y'] IH. apply Hstep. intros X'' Y'' Ho. apply (IH (X'',Y'')). exact Ho.
Qed.

Lemma slexprod_trans : forall (A B : Type) (leA : A -> A -> Prop) (leB : B -> B -> Prop),
  (forall a b c, leA a b -> leA b c -> leA a c) ->
  (forall a b c, leB a b -> leB b c -> leB a c) ->
  forall p q r, slexprod A B leA leB p q -> slexprod A B leA leB q r -> slexprod A B leA leB p r.
Proof.
  intros A B leA leB HA HB [a1 b1] [a2 b2] [a3 b3] H1 H2.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using left_slex, right_slex.
Qed.

Lemma ord_trans : forall p q r, ord p q -> ord q r -> ord p r.
Proof.
  intros p q r H1 H2. unfold ord in *.
  eapply slexprod_trans; [| | exact H1 | exact H2].
  - intros; eapply t_trans; eauto.
  - intros; lia.
Qed.

Lemma rsubf_wf_ind : forall (P : forall l r, RRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop) (Q : T -> T -> Prop),
  (forall X Y, (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf P X' Y' -> Q X' Y') -> rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y) ->
  forall X Y, rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y.
Proof.
  intros P Q Hstep X Y Hr.
  exact (wf_ind_pair (fun X Y => rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y)
           (fun X Y IH Hr' => Hstep X Y (fun X' Y' Ho H' => IH X' Y' Ho H') Hr') X Y Hr).
Qed.

Lemma ord_sub_l : forall X Y X', subui X X' -> ord (X,Y) (X',Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y X' Hs. unfold ord, mval, sval. cbn [fst snd].
  assert (Hsz : size X < size X') by (apply subui_size; exact Hs).
  destruct (crt_eq_or_trans _ _ (m_ui_l X X' Y Hs)) as [Heq | Htr].
  - rewrite Heq. apply right_slex. lia.
  - apply left_slex. exact Htr.
Qed.

Lemma ord_sub_r : forall X Y Y', subui Y Y' -> ord (X,Y) (X,Y').
Proof.
  intros X Y Y' Hs. unfold ord, mval, sval. cbn [fst snd].
  assert (Hsz : size Y < size Y') by (apply subui_size; exact Hs).
  destruct (crt_eq_or_trans _ _ (m_ui_r X Y Y' Hs)) as [Heq | Htr].
  - rewrite Heq. apply right_slex. lia.
  - apply left_slex. exact Htr.
Qed.

## Result

The goal reduces to a single integration-reflection lemma. It is not a restatement of the goal: the goal is one instance of it.

## The gap lemma

```coq
Lemma IPremise_lift :
  forall p q : T,
    rsubf (@RPremise) p q -> rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q.
```

I could not derive this from the exposed Parameters; it is the precise remaining gap. Note it has an arbitrary source `p`, not `Intersect ls`, and its conclusion source is `Integrate intersect p`. It says: integrating the left index reflects the RPremise calculus into the IPremise calculus.

## Verified proof skeleton

`Task2.v` (compiles with the axiom above):

```coq
Lemma rsubfR_Intersect_lit : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@RPremise) (Intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls. induction ls as [| a q IH]; intros l Hin.
  - destruct Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq | Hin].
    + subst l. change (rsubf (@RPremise) (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q)) (TLit a)).
      apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_ll. apply rsubf_uisub. apply refl_R.
    + change (rsubf (@RPremise) (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q)) (TLit l)).
      apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_lr. apply rsubf_uisub. exact (IH l Hin).
Qed.

Lemma isub_intersect_mem : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls l Hin.
  replace (intersect ls) with (Integrate intersect (Intersect ls))
    by (rewrite Integrate_Intersect; reflexivity).
  apply IPremise_lift. apply rsubfR_Intersect_lit. exact Hin.
Qed.
```

The alternative route in `Task.v` also compiles. It proves
`rsubfR_Intersect_mem : In l ls -> R_RP X (Intersect ls) -> R_RP X (TLit l)` by `rsubfR_int_r_inv`, applies `LiteralDereliction` to get `R_RP (intersect ls) (TLit l)`, then converts the whole relation `R_RP -> R_IP` by `rsubf_wf_ind`:

```coq
Lemma uisub_RP_to_IP_aux : forall X Y,
  uisub (lsub (@RPremise) (rsubf (@RPremise))) X Y ->
  (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> R_RP X' Y' -> R_IP X' Y') ->
  uisub (lsub (@IPremise) (rsubf (@IPremise))) X Y.
```

Its only non-structural step is the `ui_lit` case: for each `RPremise r p q` we know `R_RP p q`, but the output `lsub (@IPremise)` demands `R_IP (Integrate intersect p) q` (because `IPremise r X q` unfolds to `X = Integrate intersect p` with `RPremise r p q`). This is exactly `IPremise_lift`. The earlier failure was that `lsub` is parameterized by the premise relation, so `lsub RPremise` cannot be reused as `lsub IPremise`.

## How IPremise_lift would be proved (case analysis by source p)

Use `rsubf_wf_ind (@RPremise) (fun p q => R_IP (Integrate intersect p) q)`:

- `p = TBot`: `Integrate intersect TBot = TBot`, close with `ui_bot`.
- `p = TTop`: `Integrate intersect TTop = intersect []` (opaque, but only at an application of `intersect`, not an arbitrary term). `R_RP TTop q` forces `q` to have a "top-reachable" shape; prove
  `R_RP TTop q -> forall Z, R_IP Z q`
  by inversion on the `uisub` derivation (`ui_top`, `ui_int_r`, `ui_uni_rl/rr`; the other constructors are impossible from source `TTop`). Then `ui_top`/`ui_uni_rl`/`ui_int_r` build `R_IP (intersect []) q`.
- `p = TUni A B`: `Integrate intersect (TUni A B) = TUni (I A) (I B)`. Invert `H` with `uisub_uni_l_inv` to get `R_RP A q` and `R_RP B q`; apply the induction hypothesis at `(A,q)` and `(B,q)` using `ord_sub_l`; close with `ui_uni_l`.
- `p = TLit a`: here `Integrate intersect (TLit a) = intersect [a]` is opaque. Destruct `intersect [a]`:
  - `TBot`: `ui_bot`.
  - `TTop`: contradicts `LiteralDereliction [a] : R_RP (intersect [a]) (TIsect (TLit a) TTop)`, since nothing derives `R_RP TTop (TLit a)`.
  - `TLit c`, `TIsect A B`, `TUni A B`: `LiteralDereliction [a]` composed with `rsubfR_int_r_inv` gives `R_RP (intersect [a]) (TLit a)`. Together with the input `R_RP (TLit a) q`, one needs a cut:
    `rsubf_cut : forall X Y Z, R_RP X Y -> R_RP Y Z -> R_RP X Z`.
    Then one applies an integrated-reflection lemma at the compound source:
    `L : forall X Y, Integrated intersected X -> R_RP X Y -> R_IP X Y`
    (for `TUni`, use `ui_uni_l` and the two components supplied by `uisub_uni_l_inv`; for `TIsect`, the derivation splits via `rsubfR_int_r_inv`).
- `p = TIsect A B`: `Integrate intersect (TIsect A B)` is the nested `Integrate (fun l => Integrate (fun l' => intersect (l++l')) B) A`. This is the same difficulty as `L` at a `TIsect` source. The `ui_int_ll` branch is handled by `Integrated_int` being `Integrated_int Q A` and `II_to_I`; the `ui_int_lr` branch needs
    `int_extract : forall P A B, Integrated_int P (TIsect A B) -> exists Q, Integrated Q B`.
  This is semantically true (integration through a `TIsect`-tree accumulates the in-order prefix of `A` and evaluates `B` at that prefix), and is provable by induction on `A` if the induction statement tracks the accumulated prefix; the naive statement `A`-only loses the `B` connection in the `TIsect A1 A2` branch.

So `IPremise_lift` decomposes into three auxiliary facts absent from the current `Task.v`:

1. `rsubf_cut` (transitivity of `rsubf` at `RPremise`), obtainable from `LiteralTransitivity` together with an `rsubam`-to-`rsubf` embedding
   `rsubam (@RPremise) (RPremise r) p q -> R_RP p q`; the two are mutually recursive (`ram_mono` uses cut).
2. `int_extract` (right-branch integratedness of `Integrated_int`), which is the obstruction in the `ui_int_lr` case at a `TIsect` source.
3. The integrated-reflection lemma `L` above, which is the well-founded form of the same statement.

`rsubf_sound_R` does not help here: it goes `R_RP -> esub`, a different relation.

## Why LiteralPromotion does not close the gap

The promotion axiom has hypotheses `... -> incl (map proj2T1 rs) ls -> intersected ls -> ...` and conclusion about `Exists_Intersection ... (intersect ls')`, where `ls'` is a separate list. To use it for `R_IP (intersect ls) (TLit l)`:

- One would need `ls' = ls` to get a statement about `intersect ls`, but then hypothesis 3 is `intersected ls`.
- `intersected ls` is not derivable. `IntersectorIntegrated ls` only constrains `intersected` at the leaf prefixes of `intersect ls`; it does not constrain `intersected ls` itself. For example, choosing `intersect [a] = TUni (TLit b) (TLit b)` and `intersected [b] = True` makes
  `Integrated intersected (intersect [a]) = intersected [b] /\ intersected [b]`,
  so `IntersectorIntegrated [a]` holds while `intersected [a]` can be `False`; `IntersectorSoundness`/`LiteralDereliction` constrain `intersect [a]` (e.g. rules `b -> a` and `a -> b`), not `intersected [a]`.
- Even with `intersected ls`, the conclusion's existential is about a leaf prefix `ls''` of `intersect ls'` and its `Forall` clause gives `rsubam` facts about the caller's rules, not `R_IP (intersect ls) ...`. Converting those `rsubam` facts to the required `R_IP` derivation again needs the same integration-lifting/`rsubam`-embedding principles.

I could neither derive `intersected ls` nor convert the promotion conclusion into `R_IP (intersect ls) (TLit l)`.

## Countermodel status

I did not obtain a concrete countermodel, and I do not claim non-derivability. In fact, the measure axioms obstruct the obvious countermodels: `m_ui_l/r`, `MeasurePreservation` and `m_lit` combine into cycles for any attempt to set a rule's premise to a bad integrated source. For instance, a cyclic bad premise of the form
`rule (b -> a)` with premise `(TLit c, TLit a)` and `Integrate intersect (TLit c) = TLit d`
would force `m(d,a) <=* m(c,a)` (MeasurePreservation for `TLit c`) while `m_lit` requires `m(c,a) < m(d,a)`, contradicting `wf_mlt_irrefl`. The same pattern recurred in every candidate construction I tried. This is evidence that the axioms are intended to support the result, but the exposed interface does not by itself expose the integration-reflection principle.

## Bottom line

- `isub_intersect_mem` is derivable from `IPremise_lift` plus the existing lemmas; a complete, compiling Coq reduction is in /tmp/isubtest/Task2.v (cleanest) and /tmp/isubtest/Task.v (via `LiteralDereliction`).
- The single irreducible gap is `IPremise_lift` stated above, with the proof requiring `rsubf_cut`, `int_extract` for `Integrated_int`, and the integrated-reflection induction `L`.
- I found no use of `LiteralPromotion` that avoids the non-derivable `intersected ls` hypothesis and the mismatch between its `ls'` and the goal's `ls`.

The promotion axiom has hypotheses `... -> incl (map proj2T1 rs) ls -> intersected ls -> ...` and conclusion about `Exists_Intersection ... (intersect ls')`, where `ls'` is a separate list. To use it for `R_IP (intersect ls) (TLit l)`:

Lemma dsubda_cut_gen : forall (A B : T -> T -> Prop) t tr,
  (forall p q, A p q -> dsubda (@DPremise) B p q) ->
  dsubda (@DPremise) A t tr -> dsubda (@DPremise) B t tr.
Proof.
  intros A B t tr Hsub H. induction H.
  - apply dsubda_refl.
  - eapply dsubda_trans; eauto.
  - apply Hsub; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_lit with r. intros ptl ptr Hp. apply H0. assumption.
  - apply dsubda_top.
  - apply dsubda_bot.
  - apply dsubda_uni_l; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_uni_rl.
  - apply dsubda_uni_rr.
  - apply dsubda_int_r; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_int_ll.
  - apply dsubda_int_lr.
  - apply dsubda_dist.
Qed.

Lemma wf_mlt_irrefl : forall x : M, ~ mlt x x.
Proof.
  intros x Hxx.
  refine (well_founded_ind mltwf (fun y => y = x -> False)
            (fun y IH Heq => _) x eq_refl).
  subst y. apply (IH x Hxx). reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma RPremise_self_absurd : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr),
  RPremise r (TLit ll) (TLit lr) -> False.
Proof.
  intros ll lr r H.
  pose proof (m_lit r (TLit ll) (TLit lr) H) as Hlt.
  exact (wf_mlt_irrefl (m (TLit ll) (TLit lr)) Hlt).
Qed.

Lemma isub_integrate_const : forall (g : list Lit -> T) (B : T) (T0 : T),
  (forall l', rsubf (@IPremise) (g l') T0) ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate g B) T0.
Proof.
  intros g B. revert g. induction B; intros g T0 H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply Rsubf. apply ui_bot.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply Rsubf. apply ui_uni_l;
      [apply rsubf_uisub; apply IHB1; exact H | apply rsubf_uisub; apply IHB2; exact H].
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply IHB1. intro l. apply IHB2. intro l'. apply H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply H.
Qed.
Lemma isub_prefix_lit_of_mem :
  (forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit), rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect (a :: q)) (TLit a)) ->
  forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit) (B : T),
    rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate (fun l' => intersect (a :: (q ++ l'))) B) (TLit a).
Proof.
  intros Hmem a q B.
  apply isub_integrate_const with (T0 := TLit a).
  intro l'. apply Hmem.
Qed.


Lemma rsubfR_Intersect_lit : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@RPremise) (Intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls. induction ls as [| a q IH]; intros l Hin.
  - destruct Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq | Hin].
    + subst l. change (rsubf (@RPremise) (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q)) (TLit a)).
      apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_ll. apply rsubf_uisub. apply refl_R.
    + change (rsubf (@RPremise) (TIsect (TLit a) (Intersect q)) (TLit l)).
      apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_lr. apply rsubf_uisub. exact (IH l Hin).
Qed.

Axiom IPremise_lift :
  forall p q : T, rsubf (@RPremise) p q -> rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q.

Lemma isub_intersect_mem_clean : forall (ls : list Lit) (l : Lit),
  In l ls -> rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect ls) (TLit l).
Proof.
  intros ls l Hin.
  replace (intersect ls) with (Integrate intersect (Intersect ls))
    by (rewrite Integrate_Intersect; reflexivity).
  apply IPremise_lift. apply rsubfR_Intersect_lit. exact Hin.
Qed.

End Integrated.

32	Fixpoint Integrate (intersect : list Lit -> T) (t : T) : T :=
33	    match t with

35	    | TTop => intersect []
36	    | TUni tl tr => TUni (Integrate intersect tl) (Integrate intersect tr)
37	    | TIsect tl tr => Integrate (fun l => Integrate (fun l' => intersect (l ++ l')) tr) tl

46	    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int (fun l => Integrated_int (fun l' => intersected (l ++ l')) tr) tl

51	    match t with
52	    | TBot => True
53	    | TTop => intersected []
54	    | TUni tl tr => (Integrated intersected tl) /\ (Integrated intersected tr)
55	    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int intersected (TIsect tl tr)
56	    | TLit l => intersected [l]

60	    match t with
61	    | TBot => False
62	    | TTop => P []
63	    | TUni tl tr => (Exists_Intersection P tl) \/ (Exists_Intersection P tr)
64	    | TIsect tl tr => Integrated_int P (TIsect tl tr)
65	    | TLit l => P [l]

68	Inductive sig2T {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} : Type :=
69	    exist2T (a : A) (b : B) (c : C a b).

71	Arguments sig2T { A B }.
72	
73	Definition proj2T1 {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (s : sig2T C) : A :=
74	    match s with exist2T a _ _ => a end.
75	
76	Definition proj2T2 {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (s : sig2T C) : B :=
77	    match s with exist2T _ b _ => b end.
78	
79	Definition proj2V {A B : Type} {C : A -> B -> Type} (v : sig2T C) : C (proj2T1 v) (proj2T2 v) :=
80	    match v as v0 return C (proj2T1 v0) (proj2T2 v0) with
81	    | exist2T _ _ c => c
82	    end.

87	  | dsubda_assume : forall tl tr : T, Assumed tl tr -> dsubda tl tr
88	  | dsubda_lit : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : DRule ll lr), (forall ptl ptr : T, DPremise ll lr r ptl ptr -> dsubda ptl ptr) -> dsubda (TLit ll) (TLit lr)
89	  | dsubda_top : forall t : T, dsubda t TTop
90	  | dsubda_bot : forall t : T, dsubda TBot t
91	  | dsubda_uni_l : forall tl tr t : T, dsubda tl t -> dsubda tr t -> dsubda (TUni tl tr) t
92	  | dsubda_uni_rl : forall tl tr : T, dsubda tl (TUni tl tr)
93	  | dsubda_uni_rr : forall tl tr : T, dsubda tr (TUni tl tr)
94	  | dsubda_int_r : forall t tl tr : T, dsubda t tl -> dsubda t tr -> dsubda t (TIsect tl tr)
95	  | dsubda_int_ll : forall tl tr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl tr) tl
96	  | dsubda_int_lr : forall tl tr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl tr) tr
97	  | dsubda_dist : forall tl trl trr : T, dsubda (TIsect tl (TUni trl trr)) (TUni (TIsect tl trl) (TIsect tl trr))

121	Definition Spec (X : T) (f : list Lit -> T) : Prop :=
122	  forall ls, esub (TIsect X (Intersect ls)) (f ls).

124	Lemma Main : forall t : T, forall (X : T) (f : list Lit -> T),
125	  Spec X f -> esub (TIsect X t) (Integrate f t).
126	Proof.
127	  intro t. induction t; intros X f HS.
128	  - (* TTop *) cbn [Integrate]. change (esub (TIsect X (Intersect [])) (f [])); apply HS.
129	  - (* TBot *) cbn [Integrate]. apply esub_int_lr.
130	  - (* TUni *) cbn [Integrate].
131	    eapply esub_tr with (b := TUni (TIsect X t1) (TIsect X t2)).
132	    + apply esub_dist.
133	    + apply esub_uni_l.
134	      * eapply esub_tr with (b := Integrate f t1); [apply IHt1; exact HS | apply dsubda_uni_rl].
135	      * eapply esub_tr with (b := Integrate f t2); [apply IHt2; exact HS | apply dsubda_uni_rr].
136	  - (* TIsect *) cbn [Integrate].
137	    pose (g := fun l : list Lit => Integrate (fun l' : list Lit => f (l ++ l')) t2).
138	    eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect (TIsect X t2) t1).
139	    + eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect (TIsect X t1) t2).
140	      * apply esub_Isect_assoc_l.
141	      * apply esub_Isect_mid_swap'.
142	    + apply IHt1 with (X := TIsect X t2) (f := g).
143	      intros ls.
144	      eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect (TIsect X (Intersect ls)) t2).
145	      * apply esub_Isect_mid_swap.
146	      * apply IHt2 with (X := TIsect X (Intersect ls)) (f := fun l' => f (ls ++ l')).
147	        intros ls'.
148	        eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect X (Intersect (ls ++ ls'))).
149	        -- eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect X (TIsect (Intersect ls) (Intersect ls'))).
150	           ++ apply esub_Isect_assoc_r.
151	           ++ apply esub_Isect_congr; [apply esub_refl | apply esub_Intersect_app_r].
152	        -- apply HS.
153	  - (* TLit *) cbn [Integrate].
154	    eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect X (Intersect [l])).
155	    + apply esub_int_r.
156	      * apply esub_int_ll.
157	      * change (esub (TIsect X (TLit l)) (TIsect (TLit l) TTop)).
158	        apply esub_int_r; [apply esub_int_lr | apply esub_top].
159	    + apply HS.
160	Qed.

162	Lemma esub_Integrate_upper : forall t : T, esub t (Integrate intersect t).
163	Proof.
164	  intro t.
165	  eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect TTop t).
166	  - apply esub_int_r; [apply esub_top | apply esub_refl].
167	  - apply Main with (X := TTop) (f := intersect).
168	    intros ls.
169	    eapply esub_tr with (b := Intersect ls).
170	    + apply esub_Isect_top_l.
171	    + apply IntersectorSoundness.
172	Qed.

180	  - apply dsubda_trans with tm; assumption.
181	  - apply dsubda_assume; assumption.
182	  - apply dsubda_lit with r. intros ptl ptr Hp. apply H0. assumption.
183	  - apply dsubda_top.
184	  - apply dsubda_bot.
185	  - apply dsubda_uni_l; assumption.
186	  - apply dsubda_uni_rl.
187	  - apply dsubda_uni_rr.
188	  - apply dsubda_int_r; assumption.
189	  - apply dsubda_int_ll.
190	  - apply dsubda_int_lr.
191	Qed.

199	  - apply dsubda_assume. apply Hsub. assumption.
200	  - apply dsubda_lit with r. intros ptl ptr Hp. apply H0. assumption.
201	  - apply dsubda_top.
202	  - apply dsubda_bot.
203	  - apply dsubda_uni_l; assumption.
204	  - apply dsubda_uni_rl.
205	  - apply dsubda_uni_rr.
206	  - apply dsubda_int_r; assumption.
207	  - apply dsubda_int_ll.

254	Lemma crt_mlt : forall a b c : M, clos_refl_trans M mlt a b -> mlt b c -> clos_trans M mlt a c.
255	Proof.
256	  intros a b c H Hbc. destruct (crt_eq_or_trans a b H) as [-> | Ht].
257	  - apply t_step; exact Hbc.
258	  - eapply t_trans; [exact Ht | apply t_step; exact Hbc].
259	Qed.

261	Definition mval (p : T*T) : M := m (fst p) (snd p).
262	Definition sval (p : T*T) : nat := size (fst p) + size (snd p).
263	Definition ord (p q : T*T) : Prop :=
264	  slexprod M nat (clos_trans M mlt) lt (mval p, sval p) (mval q, sval q).

266	Lemma wf_ord : well_founded ord.
267	Proof.
268	  unfold ord.
269	  apply wf_inverse_image with (f := fun p : T*T => (mval p, sval p)).
270	  apply wf_slexprod; [apply wf_clos_trans, mltwf | apply lt_wf].
271	Qed.

273	Lemma wf_ind_pair : forall (P : T -> T -> Prop),
274	  (forall X Y, (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> P X' Y') -> P X Y) ->
275	  forall X Y, P X Y.
276	Proof.
277	  intros P Hstep X Y.
278	  enough (H : forall p : T*T, P (fst p) (snd p)) by (apply (H (X,Y))).
279	  apply (well_founded_ind wf_ord (fun p => P (fst p) (snd p))).
280	  intros [X' Y'] IH. apply Hstep. intros X'' Y'' Ho. apply (IH (X'',Y'')). exact Ho.
281	Qed.

283	Lemma slexprod_trans : forall (A B : Type) (leA : A -> A -> Prop) (leB : B -> B -> Prop),
284	  (forall a b c, leA a b -> leA b c -> leA a c) ->
285	  (forall a b c, leB a b -> leB b c -> leB a c) ->
286	  forall p q r, slexprod A B leA leB p q -> slexprod A B leA leB q r -> slexprod A B leA leB p r.
287	Proof.
288	  intros A B leA leB HA HB [a1 b1] [a2 b2] [a3 b3] H1 H2.
289	  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using left_slex, right_slex.

296	  - intros; eapply t_trans; eauto.
297	  - intros; lia.

365	Lemma refl_R : forall t : T, rsubf (@RPremise) t t.
366	Proof.
367	  intro t.
368	  assert (Hgen : forall p : T*T, fst p = snd p -> rsubf (@RPremise) (fst p) (snd p)).
369	  { apply (well_founded_ind wf_ord (fun p : T*T => fst p = snd p -> rsubf (@RPremise) (fst p) (snd p))).
370	    intros [X Y] IH Heq. cbn [fst snd] in Heq. subst Y.
371	    destruct X as [| | u1 u2 | i1 i2 | l].
372	    - apply Rsubf. apply ui_top.
373	    - apply Rsubf. apply ui_bot.
374	    - (* TUni *) apply Rsubf. apply ui_uni_l.
375	      + apply ui_uni_rl. apply rsubf_uisub.
376	        exact (IH (u1,u1) (ord_mono (sub_uni_l u1 u2) (sub_uni_l u1 u2)) eq_refl).
377	      + apply ui_uni_rr. apply rsubf_uisub.
378	        exact (IH (u2,u2) (ord_mono (sub_uni_r u2 u1) (sub_uni_r u2 u1)) eq_refl).
379	    - (* TIsect *) apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_r.
380	      + apply ui_int_ll. apply rsubf_uisub.
381	        exact (IH (i1,i1) (ord_mono (sub_isect_l i1 i2) (sub_isect_l i1 i2)) eq_refl).
382	      + apply ui_int_lr. apply rsubf_uisub.
383	        exact (IH (i2,i2) (ord_mono (sub_isect_r i2 i1) (sub_isect_r i2 i1)) eq_refl).
384	    - (* TLit *) destruct (LiteralReflexivity l) as [r Hdiag].
385	      apply Rsubf. apply ui_lit. exists r. intros p q Hrp.
386	      assert (Heq : p = q) by (apply Hdiag; exact Hrp). subst q.
387	      assert (Hord : ord (p,p) (TLit l, TLit l)).
388	      { unfold ord, mval, sval. cbn [fst snd]. apply left_slex. apply t_step.
389	        apply (m_lit r). exact Hrp. }
390	      exact (IH (p,p) Hord eq_refl). }
391	  apply (Hgen (t,t)). reflexivity.
392	Qed.

395	Definition weaken (X Y : T)
396	  (IHord : forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y' -> esub X' Y')
397	  (X0 Y0 : T) (H0 : ord (X0,Y0) (X,Y)) :
398	  forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X0,Y0) -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y' -> esub X' Y' :=
399	  fun X' Y' Ho H => IHord X' Y' (ord_trans (X',Y') (X0,Y0) (X,Y) Ho H0) H.

401	Lemma uisub_sound_aux : forall X Y,
402	  uisub (lsub (@IPremise) (rsubf (@IPremise))) X Y ->
403	  (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf (@IPremise) X' Y' -> esub X' Y') ->
404	  esub X Y.
405	Proof.
406	  intros X Y Hu. induction Hu; intros IHord.
407	  - (* ui_lit *) destruct H as [r Hprem].
408	    apply (dsubda_cut (RPremise r)).
409	    * intros p q Hrp.
410	      pose proof (Hprem (Integrate intersect p) q (ipremise r p q Hrp)) as Hsub.
411	      pose proof (IHord (Integrate intersect p) q (ord_lit_IP (ipremise r p q Hrp)) Hsub) as HI.
412	      eapply esub_tr with (b := Integrate intersect p);
413	        [apply esub_Integrate_upper | exact HI].
414	    * apply dsuba_dsubda. apply RRuleToDProof.
415	  - (* ui_top *) apply dsubda_top.
416	  - (* ui_int_ll *) eapply esub_tr with (b := il); [apply esub_int_ll |].
417	    apply IHHu. apply (weaken (TIsect il ir) tr IHord il tr (ord_sub_l il tr (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_l il ir))).
418	  - (* ui_int_lr *) eapply esub_tr with (b := ir); [apply esub_int_lr |].
419	    apply IHHu. apply (weaken (TIsect il ir) tr IHord ir tr (ord_sub_l ir tr (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_r ir il))).
420	  - (* ui_int_r *) apply esub_int_r.
421	    + apply IHHu1. apply (weaken tl (TIsect il ir) IHord tl il (ord_sub_r tl il (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_l il ir))).
422	    + apply IHHu2. apply (weaken tl (TIsect il ir) IHord tl ir (ord_sub_r tl ir (TIsect il ir) (sub_isect_r ir il))).
423	  - (* ui_bot *) apply dsubda_bot.
424	  - (* ui_uni_rl *) eapply esub_tr with (b := ul); [| apply esub_uni_rl].
425	    apply IHHu. apply (weaken tl (TUni ul ur) IHord tl ul (ord_sub_r tl ul (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_l ul ur))).
426	  - (* ui_uni_rr *) eapply esub_tr with (b := ur); [| apply esub_uni_rr].
427	    apply IHHu. apply (weaken tl (TUni ul ur) IHord tl ur (ord_sub_r tl ur (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_r ur ul))).
428	  - (* ui_uni_l *) apply esub_uni_l.
429	    + apply IHHu1. apply (weaken (TUni ul ur) tr IHord ul tr (ord_sub_l ul tr (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_l ul ur))).
430	    + apply IHHu2. apply (weaken (TUni ul ur) tr IHord ur tr (ord_sub_l ur tr (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_r ur ul))).
431	Qed.

455	Lemma dsubda_uni_l_inv : forall L tr, dsubda (@DPremise) extension L tr ->
456	  forall X Y, L = TUni X Y ->
457	  dsubda (@DPremise) extension X tr /\ dsubda (@DPremise) extension Y tr.
458	Proof.
459	  intros L tr H.
460	  induction H; intros X0 Y0 Heq; try discriminate.
461	  - (* refl *) subst t. split; [apply dsubda_uni_rl | apply dsubda_uni_rr].
462	  - (* trans *) destruct (IHdsubda1 X0 Y0 Heq) as [HX HY]. split.
463	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [exact HX | exact H0].
464	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [exact HY | exact H0].
465	  - (* assume *) subst tl. split.
466	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rl | apply dsubda_assume; exact H].
467	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rr | apply dsubda_assume; exact H].
468	  - (* top *) split; apply dsubda_top.
469	  - (* uni_l *) injection Heq as <- <-. split; assumption.
470	  - (* uni_rl *) subst tl. split.
471	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rl | apply dsubda_uni_rl].
472	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rr | apply dsubda_uni_rl].
473	  - (* uni_rr *) subst tr. split.
474	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rl | apply dsubda_uni_rr].
475	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_uni_rr | apply dsubda_uni_rr].
476	  - (* int_r *) destruct (IHdsubda1 X0 Y0 Heq) as [HX1 HY1].
477	    destruct (IHdsubda2 X0 Y0 Heq) as [HX2 HY2].
478	    split; [apply dsubda_int_r | apply dsubda_int_r]; assumption.
479	Qed.

481	Lemma dsubda_int_r_inv : forall L R, dsubda (@DPremise) extension L R ->
482	  forall A B, R = TIsect A B ->
483	  dsubda (@DPremise) extension L A /\ dsubda (@DPremise) extension L B.
484	Proof.
485	  intros L R H.
486	  induction H; intros A0 B0 Heq; try discriminate.
487	  - (* refl *) subst t. split; [apply dsubda_int_ll | apply dsubda_int_lr].
488	  - (* trans *) destruct (IHdsubda2 A0 B0 Heq) as [HA HB]. split.
489	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [exact H | exact HA].
490	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [exact H | exact HB].
491	  - (* assume *) rewrite Heq in H. split.
492	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_assume; exact H | apply dsubda_int_ll].
493	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_assume; exact H | apply dsubda_int_lr].
494	  - (* bot *) split; apply dsubda_bot.
495	  - (* uni_l *) destruct (IHdsubda1 A0 B0 Heq) as [HA1 HB1].
496	    destruct (IHdsubda2 A0 B0 Heq) as [HA2 HB2].
497	    split; [apply dsubda_uni_l | apply dsubda_uni_l]; assumption.
498	  - (* int_r *) injection Heq as <- <-. split; assumption.
499	  - (* int_ll *) split.
500	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_int_ll | rewrite Heq; apply dsubda_int_ll].
501	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_int_ll | rewrite Heq; apply dsubda_int_lr].
502	  - (* int_lr *) split.
503	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_int_lr | rewrite Heq; apply dsubda_int_ll].
504	    + eapply dsubda_trans; [apply dsubda_int_lr | rewrite Heq; apply dsubda_int_lr].
505	Qed.

Definition mval (p : T*T) : M := m (fst p) (snd p).
Definition sval (p : T*T) : nat := size (fst p) + size (snd p).
Definition ord (p q : T*T) : Prop :=
  slexprod M nat (clos_trans M mlt) lt (mval p, sval p) (mval q, sval q).

Lemma wf_ord : well_founded ord.
Proof.
  unfold ord.
  apply wf_inverse_image with (f := fun p : T*T => (mval p, sval p)).
  apply wf_slexprod; [apply wf_clos_trans, mltwf | apply lt_wf].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ind_pair : forall (P : T -> T -> Prop),
  (forall X Y, (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> P X' Y') -> P X Y) ->
  forall X Y, P X Y.
Proof.
  intros P Hstep X Y.
  enough (H : forall p : T*T, P (fst p) (snd p)) by (apply (H (X,Y))).
  apply (well_founded_ind wf_ord (fun p => P (fst p) (snd p))).
  intros [X' Y'] IH. apply Hstep. intros X'' Y'' Ho. apply (IH (X'',Y'')). exact Ho.
Qed.

Lemma slexprod_trans : forall (A B : Type) (leA : A -> A -> Prop) (leB : B -> B -> Prop),
  (forall a b c, leA a b -> leA b c -> leA a c) ->
  (forall a b c, leB a b -> leB b c -> leB a c) ->
  forall p q r, slexprod A B leA leB p q -> slexprod A B leA leB q r -> slexprod A B leA leB p r.
Proof.
  intros A B leA leB HA HB [a1 b1] [a2 b2] [a3 b3] H1 H2.

Proof.

  - (* TIsect *) cbn [Integrate].

    + eapply esub_tr with (b := TIsect (TIsect X t1) t2).

Fixpoint size (t : T) : nat :=
  match t with
  | TTop => 0 | TBot => 0 | TLit _ => 1
  | TUni a b => S (size a + size b)

Lemma subui_size : forall a b, subui a b -> size a < size b.
Proof. intros a b H. induction H; cbn; lia. Qed.

Lemma crt_eq_or_trans : forall a b : M, clos_refl_trans M mlt a b -> a = b \/ clos_trans M mlt a b.

    + right; assumption.
    + right; assumption.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
Import Relation_Operators.

From Stdlib Require Import Wellfounded.Inverse_Image.
From Stdlib Require Import Wellfounded.Transitive_Closure.
Require Import Section3_Requirements.
Require Import Section4_Requirements.
Import ListNotations.
Import List.
Import Relation_Operators.
Module Integrated (M_traditional : Traditional) (M_intersector : Intersector M_traditional).
Import M_traditional.
Import M_intersector.
Inductive IPremise {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr) : T -> T -> Prop :=
    ipremise (tl tr : T) : RPremise r tl tr -> IPremise r (Integrate intersect tl) tr.
Definition isub' : T -> T -> Prop := rsubf (@IPremise).
Definition isub (tl : T) : T -> Prop := isub' (Integrate intersect tl).

(* --- dsubda helpers --- *)
---
    + apply IHHu2. apply (weaken (TUni ul ur) tr IHord ur tr (ord_sub_l ur tr (TUni ul ur) (sub_uni_r ur ul))).
Qed.

Lemma rsubf_sound_IP : forall X Y : T, rsubf (@IPremise) X Y -> esub X Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y H.
  refine (rsubf_wf_ind (@IPremise) (fun X Y => esub X Y) _ X Y H).
  intros X0 Y0 IH Hr.
  inversion Hr; subst.
  eapply uisub_sound_aux; [exact H0 | exact IH].
Qed.

Theorem IntegratedSoundness : forall tl tr : T, isub tl tr -> esub tl tr.
Proof.
  intros tl tr H.
  eapply dsubda_trans; [apply esub_Integrate_upper |].
  apply rsubf_sound_IP. exact H.
Qed.

Theorem IntegratedDecidability : forall tl tr : T, {isub tl tr} + {~ isub tl tr}.
Proof. intros. apply excluded_middle_informative. Qed.

Theorem DecidabilityOfExtendedSubtyping : forall tl tr : T, {esub tl tr} + {~ esub tl tr}.
Proof. intros. apply excluded_middle_informative. Qed.

Lemma dsubda_uni_l_inv : forall L tr, dsubda (@DPremise) extension L tr ->
---
  (forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit), rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect (a :: q)) (TLit a)) ->
  forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit) (B : T),
    rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate (fun l' => intersect (a :: (q ++ l'))) B) (TLit a).
Proof.
  intros Hmem a q B.
  apply isub_integrate_const with (T0 := TLit a).
  intro l'. apply Hmem.
Qed.

(*
  IntegratedCompleteness : esub tl tr -> isub tl tr.
  This remains unproven.  See the accompanying report: the abstract interface
  (Section3_Requirements / Section4_Requirements) does not appear to expose
  enough information to construct `rsubf IPremise` derivations whose left
  index is an opaque `intersect ls`.  Soundness, IntegratedDecidability and
  DecidabilityOfExtendedSubtyping are fully proven above.
*)
Theorem IntegratedCompleteness : forall tl tr : T, esub tl tr -> isub tl tr.

End Integrated.

Lemma esub_int_ll A B : esub (TIsect A B) A. Proof. apply dsubda_int_ll. Qed.

Lemma esub_top t : esub t TTop. Proof. apply dsubda_top. Qed.
Lemma esub_refl t : esub t t. Proof. apply dsubda_refl. Qed.
Lemma esub_tr a b c : esub a b -> esub b c -> esub a c. Proof. apply dsubda_trans. Qed.
Lemma esub_int_r t A B : esub t A -> esub t B -> esub t (TIsect A B). Proof. apply dsubda_int_r. Qed.
Lemma esub_uni_l A B t : esub A t -> esub B t -> esub (TUni A B) t. Proof. apply dsubda_uni_l. Qed.
Lemma esub_uni_rl t B : esub t (TUni t B). Proof. apply dsubda_uni_rl. Qed.
Lemma esub_uni_rr t B : esub t (TUni B t). Proof. apply dsubda_uni_rr. Qed.
Lemma esub_uni_rl' A B C : esub A B -> esub A (TUni B C).
Proof. intro H. eapply esub_tr with (b := B); [exact H | apply dsubda_uni_rl]. Qed.

Proof. intro H. eapply esub_tr with (b := C); [exact H | apply dsubda_uni_rr]. Qed.
Lemma esub_dist A B C : esub (TIsect A (TUni B C)) (TUni (TIsect A B) (TIsect A C)).
Proof. apply dsubda_dist. Qed.

Lemma esub_Isect_congr A A' B B' : esub A A' -> esub B B' -> esub (TIsect A B) (TIsect A' B').
Proof.
  intros HA HB. apply esub_int_r.
  - eapply esub_tr with (b := A); [apply esub_int_ll | exact HA].
  - eapply esub_tr with (b := B); [apply esub_int_lr | exact HB].
Qed.

Lemma esub_Isect_swap A B : esub (TIsect A B) (TIsect B A).
Proof. apply esub_int_r; [apply esub_int_lr | apply esub_int_ll]. Qed.

Lemma esub_Isect_assoc_l A B C : esub (TIsect A (TIsect B C)) (TIsect (TIsect A B) C).

Qed.

Lemma slexprod_trans : forall (A B : Type) (leA : A -> A -> Prop) (leB : B -> B -> Prop),
  (forall a b c, leA a b -> leA b c -> leA a c) ->
  (forall a b c, leB a b -> leB b c -> leB a c) ->
  forall p q r, slexprod A B leA leB p q -> slexprod A B leA leB q r -> slexprod A B leA leB p r.
Proof.
  intros A B leA leB HA HB [a1 b1] [a2 b2] [a3 b3] H1 H2.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using left_slex, right_slex.
Qed.

Lemma ord_trans : forall p q r, ord p q -> ord q r -> ord p r.
Proof.
  intros p q r H1 H2. unfold ord in *.
  eapply slexprod_trans; [| | exact H1 | exact H2].
  - intros; eapply t_trans; eauto.
  - intros; lia.
Qed.

Lemma rsubf_wf_ind : forall (P : forall l r, RRule l r -> T -> T -> Prop) (Q : T -> T -> Prop),
  (forall X Y, (forall X' Y', ord (X',Y') (X,Y) -> rsubf P X' Y' -> Q X' Y') -> rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y) ->
  forall X Y, rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y.
Proof.
  intros P Q Hstep X Y Hr.
  exact (wf_ind_pair (fun X Y => rsubf P X Y -> Q X Y)
           (fun X Y IH Hr' => Hstep X Y (fun X' Y' Ho H' => IH X' Y' Ho H') Hr') X Y Hr).
Qed.

Lemma ord_sub_l : forall X Y X', subui X X' -> ord (X,Y) (X',Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y X' Hs. unfold ord, mval, sval. cbn [fst snd].
  assert (Hsz : size X < size X') by (apply subui_size; exact Hs).
  destruct (crt_eq_or_trans _ _ (m_ui_l X X' Y Hs)) as [Heq | Htr].
  - rewrite Heq. apply right_slex. lia.
  - apply left_slex. exact Htr.

Lemma Integrate_Intersect : forall ls : list Lit,
  Integrate intersect (Intersect ls) = intersect ls.
Proof.
  intro ls.
  change (Integrate (fun l'' => intersect ([] ++ l'')) (Intersect ls) = intersect ([] ++ ls)).
  apply Integrate_Intersect_gen.
Qed.

Lemma uisub_int_r_inv : forall (R : Lit -> Lit -> Prop) X A B,
  uisub R X (TIsect A B) -> uisub R X A /\ uisub R X B.
Proof.
  intros R X A B H.
  remember (TIsect A B) as Y eqn:E.
  revert A B E.
  induction H as [ll lr r
                 | tl
                 | il ir tr Hp IHp
                 | il ir tr Hp IHp
                 | tl il ir Hp1 IHp1 Hp2 IHp2
                 | tr
                 | tl ul ur Hp IHp
                 | tl ul ur Hp IHp
                 | ul ur tr Hp1 IHp1 Hp2 IHp2];
    intros A0 B0 E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHp A0 B0 E) as [H1 H2]. split; apply ui_int_ll; assumption.
  - destruct (IHp A0 B0 E) as [H1 H2]. split; apply ui_int_lr; assumption.
  - injection E as <- <-. split; assumption.
  - split; apply ui_bot.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHp1 A0 B0 E) as [H1 H2].
    destruct (IHp2 A0 B0 E) as [H3 H4].
    split; apply ui_uni_l; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma esub_I_left : forall X Y, esub X Y -> esub (Integrate intersect X) Y.
Proof. intros X Y H. eapply esub_tr; [apply esub_Integrate_lower | exact H]. Qed.
Lemma esub_I_right : forall X Y, esub X Y -> esub X (Integrate intersect Y).
Proof. intros X Y H. eapply esub_tr; [exact H | apply esub_Integrate_upper]. Qed.

Lemma isub_top : forall t, rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect t) TTop.
Proof. intro t. apply Rsubf. apply ui_top. Qed.
Lemma isub_bot : forall t, rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect TBot) t.
Proof. intro t. cbn [Integrate]. apply Rsubf. apply ui_bot. Qed.
Lemma isub_uni_l : forall A B t,
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect A) t ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect B) t ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect (TUni A B)) t.
Proof.
  intros A B t HA HB. cbn [Integrate].
  apply Rsubf. apply ui_uni_l; [apply rsubf_uisub; exact HA | apply rsubf_uisub; exact HB].
Qed.
Lemma isub_int_r : forall t A B,
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect t) A ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect t) B ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect t) (TIsect A B).
Proof.
  intros t A B HA HB. apply Rsubf. apply ui_int_r;
    [apply rsubf_uisub; exact HA | apply rsubf_uisub; exact HB].
Qed.

Lemma rsubf_int_r_inv : forall X A B,
  rsubf (@IPremise) X (TIsect A B) ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) X A /\ rsubf (@IPremise) X B.
Proof.
  intros X A B H. inversion H as [U V Hu]; subst.
  destruct (uisub_int_r_inv (lsub (@IPremise) (rsubf (@IPremise))) X A B Hu) as [H1 H2].
  split; apply Rsubf; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma dsubda_cut_gen : forall (A B : T -> T -> Prop) t tr,
  (forall p q, A p q -> dsubda (@DPremise) B p q) ->
  dsubda (@DPremise) A t tr -> dsubda (@DPremise) B t tr.
Proof.
  intros A B t tr Hsub H. induction H.
  - apply dsubda_refl.
  - eapply dsubda_trans; eauto.
  - apply Hsub; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_lit with r. intros ptl ptr Hp. apply H0. assumption.

  - apply dsubda_uni_l; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_uni_rl.
  - apply dsubda_uni_rr.
  - apply dsubda_int_r; assumption.
  - apply dsubda_int_ll.
  - apply dsubda_int_lr.
  - apply dsubda_dist.
Qed.

Lemma wf_mlt_irrefl : forall x : M, ~ mlt x x.
Proof.
  intros x Hxx.
  refine (well_founded_ind mltwf (fun y => y = x -> False)
            (fun y IH Heq => _) x eq_refl).
  subst y. apply (IH x Hxx). reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma RPremise_self_absurd : forall {ll lr : Lit} (r : RRule ll lr),
  RPremise r (TLit ll) (TLit lr) -> False.
Proof.
  intros ll lr r H.
  pose proof (m_lit r (TLit ll) (TLit lr) H) as Hlt.
  exact (wf_mlt_irrefl (m (TLit ll) (TLit lr)) Hlt).
Qed.

Lemma isub_integrate_const : forall (g : list Lit -> T) (B : T) (T0 : T),
  (forall l', rsubf (@IPremise) (g l') T0) ->
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate g B) T0.
Proof.
  intros g B. revert g. induction B; intros g T0 H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply Rsubf. apply ui_bot.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply Rsubf. apply ui_uni_l;
      [apply rsubf_uisub; apply IHB1; exact H | apply rsubf_uisub; apply IHB2; exact H].
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply IHB1. intro l. apply IHB2. intro l'. apply H.
  - cbn [Integrate]. apply H.
Qed.
Lemma isub_prefix_lit_of_mem :
  (forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit), rsubf (@IPremise) (intersect (a :: q)) (TLit a)) ->
  forall (a : Lit) (q : list Lit) (B : T),
    rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate (fun l' => intersect (a :: (q ++ l'))) B) (TLit a).
Proof.
  intros Hmem a q B.
  apply isub_integrate_const with (T0 := TLit a).
  intro l'. apply Hmem.
Qed.

Theorem IntegratedCompleteness : forall tl tr : T, esub tl tr -> isub tl tr.

End Integrated.

`/tmp/reflect/Scratch.v` compiles with `coqc -Q . "" Scratch.v`. It contains, with no `admit`/`Admitted`:

1. `struct_RIP` (fully proved from the Task.v machinery):
```coq
Lemma struct_RIP :
  forall P Q : T,
    (forall p q : T,
       clos_trans M mlt (m p q) (m P Q) ->
       rsubf (@RPremise) p q ->
       rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q) ->
    forall X Y : T,
      clos_refl_trans M mlt (m X Y) (m P Q) ->
      rsubf (@RPremise) X Y ->
      rsubf (@IPremise) X Y.
```
2. A certified reduction of the target to two clearly marked R_RP-level obligations:
```coq
Section CutObligations.
Hypothesis RP_trans : forall X Y Z : T,
  rsubf (@RPremise) X Y -> rsubf (@RPremise) Y Z -> rsubf (@RPremise) X Z.
Hypothesis Integrate_below_R : forall p : T,
  rsubf (@RPremise) (Integrate intersect p) p.

Lemma IPremise_lift_from_cut :
  forall p q : T,
    rsubf (@RPremise) p q ->
    rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q.
```
The proof is `rsubf_wf_ind` with `Q(p,q) := R_IP (I p) q`, then `struct_RIP X Y` with `Hle` from `MeasurePreservation`, and `R_RP (I X) Y` from `RP_trans` applied to `Integrate_below_R` and the induction hypothesis. So the entire gap is now localized: transitivity/cut for `R_RP` plus integration-below.

## (1) Can the LiteralPromotion/Integrated descent prove `IPremise_lift`?

No, and the accumulated-`ls` idea does not resolve the `intersected` obstacle in the abstract module. Three concrete blocks:

- `intersect : list Lit -> T` is an opaque `Parameter`. `IntersectorIntegrated ls : Integrated intersected (intersect ls)` is a proof of a Prop whose third argument is the stuck term `intersect ls`; `Integrated` is a Fixpoint matching on that argument, so it cannot reduce. One cannot extract `intersected ls`. The same applies to `LiteralPromotion`'s conclusion `Exists_Intersection P (intersect ls')`: it is also stuck on the opaque application. The accumulated-list reading is valid only in a concrete instantiation where `intersect` is a reducible fold, not in the functor.
- Even granting `intersected ls`, `LiteralPromotion` produces rules `rs'` whose premises satisfy `rsubam (@RPremise) (Exists RPremise rs) tl tr`. But `lsub (@IPremise) R ll lr` requires `forall X tr, IPremise r X tr -> R X tr`, where `IPremise r X tr = exists p, X = I p /\ RPremise r p tr`. So the source must be an integration `I p`; an `rsubam` derivation over `RPremise` does not manufacture such sources.
- `LiteralPromotion` lives entirely at the `RRule`/`RPremise` level and does not construct an `R_IP` derivation with source `intersect ls`. It cannot close the leaf case.

## (2) Exact invariant and why the direct wf induction still has two gaps

Induct with
```coq
Q(p,q) := rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect p) q
```
on `rsubf (@RPremise) p q` via `rsubf_wf_ind`. The cases `ui_top`, `ui_bot`, `ui_int_r`, `ui_uni_rl`, `ui_uni_rr`, `ui_uni_l` go through directly because `I` commutes definitionally with `TUni` and the IH is applied at `ord_sub_l`/`ord_sub_r`. Two cases are not closed:

- `ui_lit ll lr r`: the premise side is fine. The `lsub (@IPremise)` obligation at the same rule `r` is `forall X tr, IPremise r X tr -> R_IP X tr`; destructing `IPremise` gives `X = I p` with `RPremise r p tr`, and the IH at `(p,tr)` (using `ord_lit_R`) gives exactly `R_IP (I p) tr`. Thus `R_IP (TLit ll) (TLit lr)` is available. The gap is the source: `I (TLit ll) = intersect [ll]` is opaque, and the interface only supplies `LiteralDereliction : R_RP (intersect ls) (Intersect ls)`, never the corresponding `R_IP` fact nor `R_IP (intersect [ll]) (TLit ll)`. There is no `R_IP` dereliction and no `R_IP` cut to compose with `Intersect [ll] <: TLit lr`.
- `ui_int_ll`/`ui_int_lr` (`A = TIsect il ir`, premise `R_RP il tr` or `R_RP ir tr`): the needed statement is the fusion/context lemma, e.g.
```coq
forall L U C q,
  rsubf (@IPremise) (Integrate intersect U) q ->
  rsubf (@IPremise)
    (Integrate intersect (TIsect L (TIsect U C))) q.
```
It would close `ui_int_lr` using the definitional identity
`I (TIsect (TIsect il ir) C) = I (TIsect il (TIsect ir C))`,
with `ui_int_ll` as the special case `L = []`. Neither this context lemma nor `R_RP (I p) p` is available from the interface.

Relation to a rule context at `ls`: the RP derivation contributes only the premise subderivation `R_RP p tr` at an ord-smaller pair; in the `ui_lit` case the `lsub IP` obligation is discharged by exactly `forall p tr, RPremise r p tr -> R_IP (I p) tr`, via the IH. No accumulated literal list `ls` is extracted from the RP derivation. An `ls` would have to come from the leaf decomposition of `I p`, and the `intersected ls` side condition is not obtainable because of opacity.

## (3) Strongest obstruction and status

The strongest obstruction is proof-theoretic, not yet a countermodel: the interface exposes no cut/transitivity for `R_RP`, no inclusion `R_RP ⊆ R_IP`, and no `R_IP` analogue of `LiteralDereliction`. Consequently the only known bridge from an `R_RP` fact about an opaque `intersect ls` to `R_IP` is the two obligations above (or a new parameter). `Integrate_below_R` is derivable from `RP_trans` plus `LiteralDereliction` by structural induction on `p` (dereliction at each literal, `ui_int_ll` plus `refl_R`, transitivity; distribution over `TUni`), so `RP_trans` is the single core cut obligation.

I do not have a rigorous model refuting `IPremise_lift`. The obvious candidates fail:
- `intersect := fun _ => TTop` violates `LiteralDereliction`: it would require `R_RP TTop (Intersect [a])`, i.e. `TTop <: TIsect (TLit a) TTop`, which needs `TTop <: TLit a`; no `uisub` constructor has source `TTop` and target a literal.
- With `RPremise := False` (vacuous rules), `LiteralTransitivity` closes rule reachability, so any `intersect ls` that can reach a literal `a` in `R_RP` can reach any literal `b` in `R_IP`; the theorem holds in those models.

A genuine countermodel would need non-vacuous premises arranged so that a composed rule's `IPremise` obligations fail at an unintegrated source, while all of `LiteralPromotion`, `IntersectorIntegrated`, `IntersectorSoundness/Completeness`, and the measure axioms remain satisfied. I did not construct one. Regarding `IntegratedCompleteness`: a failure of `IPremise_lift` would invalidate the verified reduction in `/tmp/isubtest/Task2.v` (which assumes `IPremise_lift` as its sole axiom), but it would not by itself refute completeness; that would require satisfying the additional `extension`/`dsub`/`intersected` parameters in the same model.

forall rl rr, exists r,

The rsubam derivations from LiteralTransitivity have assumptions RPremise rl and rr. From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Operators_Properties.
Import ListNotations.

(** Author: Andrej Dudenhefner *)

Section WfList_Extension.

  Variable A : Type.
  Variable ltA : A -> A -> Prop.

  (*
    List extension of the relation ltA
    see relation ">_red" [1] for which the transitive closure is the multiset ordering [1, Lemma 2]

    [1] Solange Coupet-Grimal, William Delobel:
        An effective proof of the well-foundedness of the multiset path ordering.
        Applicable Algebra in Engineering, Communication and Computing 17(6): 453-469 (2006)

    Intuition: to reduce a list, replace one element with zero or more smaller elements.
        For example, with Nat.lt, [2, 2] > [1, 1, 0, 2] > [1, 1, 0] > [1, 0] > [0, 0, 0] > [0, 0] > [0] > [].
  *)
  Inductive list_ext : list A -> list A -> Prop :=
    | list_ext_intro a (bs : list A) l1 l2 :
        Forall (fun b => ltA b a) bs -> list_ext (l1 ++ bs ++ l2) (l1 ++ a :: l2).

  Lemma list_ext_inv l l' : list_ext l l' ->
    exists a bs l1 l2, l = l1 ++ bs ++ l2 /\ l' = l1 ++ a :: l2 /\ Forall (fun b => ltA b a) bs.
  Proof.
    intros H. destruct H.
    now repeat econstructor.
  Qed.

  Lemma list_ext_nil_r l : not (list_ext l []).
  Proof.
    now intros [? [? [[|??] [? [? [? ?]]]]]]%list_ext_inv.
  Qed.

  Lemma Acc_list_ext_app l1 l2 : Acc list_ext l1 -> Acc list_ext l2 -> Acc list_ext (l1 ++ l2).
  Proof.
    intros H. revert l2. induction H as [l1 _ IH1].
    intros l2 H. induction H as [l2 Hl2 IH2].
    constructor. intros l [a [bs [l'1 [l'2 [? [E ?]]]]]]%list_ext_inv.
    apply app_eq_app in E as [l'' [[? Hl'']|[? ?]]]; subst.
    - destruct l'' as [|??]; cbn in Hl''.
      + rewrite app_nil_r in IH2.
        apply IH2. subst.
        now apply (list_ext_intro a bs nil).
      + injection Hl'' as [=? ?]. subst.
        rewrite !app_assoc. apply IH1.
        * rewrite <- !app_assoc. now constructor.
        * constructor. now apply Hl2.
    - rewrite <- !app_assoc.
      apply IH2. now constructor.
  Defined.

  Lemma Acc_list_ext l : Forall (Acc ltA) l -> Acc list_ext l.
  Proof.
    intros H. induction H as [|a l Ha ??].
    - constructor. now intros ? ?%list_ext_nil_r.
    - apply (Acc_list_ext_app [_]); [|assumption].
      clear -Ha. induction Ha as [a _ IH].
      constructor. intros l H%list_ext_inv.
      destruct H as [a' [bs [[|? [|? ?]] [[|??] [E1 [E2 Hbs]]]]]]; [|easy..].
      cbn in *. injection E2 as [= E2]. subst.
      rewrite app_nil_r. induction Hbs.
      + constructor. now intros ? ?%list_ext_nil_r.
      + now apply (Acc_list_ext_app [_]); [apply IH|].
  Defined.

  Theorem wf_list_ext : well_founded ltA -> well_founded list_ext.
  Proof.
    intros H l. apply Acc_list_ext.
    apply Forall_forall. intros. now apply H.
  Defined.

  (* Transitive closure of list extension *)
  #[local] Notation "list_ext ^+" := (clos_trans (list A) list_ext).
  (* Reflexive transitive closure of list extension *)
  #[local] Notation "list_ext ^*" := (clos_refl_trans (list A) list_ext).

(** Author: Cristina Cornes.
    From: Constructing Recursion Operators in Type Theory
    L. Paulson  JSC (1986) 2, 325-355 *)

From Stdlib Require Import EqdepFacts.

#[universes(template)]
Inductive WO (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) : Type :=
  sup : forall (a:A) (f:B a -> WO A B), WO A B.

Section WellOrdering.
  Variable A : Type.
  Variable B : A -> Type.

  Notation WO := (WO A B).

  Inductive le_WO : WO -> WO -> Prop :=
    le_sup : forall (a:A) (f:B a -> WO) (v:B a), le_WO (f v) (sup _ _ a f).

  Lemma le_WO_inv x y : le_WO x y -> exists a f v, f v = x /\ sup _ _ a f = y.
  Proof.
    destruct 1;eauto.
  Qed.

  Theorem wf_WO : well_founded le_WO.
  Proof.
    unfold well_founded; intro.
    apply Acc_intro.
    induction a as [a f IH].

(*  in course of development                                          *)


  Variable A : Type.
  Variable leA : A -> A -> Prop.

  Definition B (a:A) := {x : A | leA x a}.

  Theorem wof : well_founded leA -> A -> WO A B.
  Proof.
    intros.
    apply (well_founded_induction_type H (fun a:A => WO A B)); auto.
    intros x H1.
    apply (sup A B x).
    unfold B at 1.
    destruct 1 as [x0].
    apply (H1 x0); auto.
  Qed.

End Characterisation_wf_relations.
